name: Kokoro
source: An unserious student. A slacker who failed to pass his exams. But he's a guy with decent natural smarts. The type who's easy to get along with and has lots of friends, but somehow remains detached. He doesn't like dealing with trouble. For now, he thinks maintaining the status quo is just fine.
